models.limits: The existing model abstracts accepted record values and TTL and checks the unchanged storage change/receipt transition. It does not model SRV priority, weight, port, targets, numeric parsing, DNS lookup, or prove refinement to Go/SQLite.

changes.reason: Native Go tests for the finite SRV grammar plus authenticated owner-scoped Changes, readback, stale deletion rollback, restart and cleanup; no model or runtime hook.
